result.description: Cloud platform for web scraping and automation: run Actors (serverless scrapers/tools), store data in datasets/key-value stores, and browse Actors in Apify Store.
result.auth_detail: Personal API token from Console Integrations page, sent as Bearer header (recommended) or ?token= query param. OAuth is documented only for the MCP server connection, not the REST API. Also x402/Skyfire payment credentials for agentic pay-per-call.
result.access_detail: Free plan ($0, $5 monthly usage, no credit card) with token creation in Console. Pricing page does not explicitly state free-plan API access, but the free plan covers most platform features. Paid plans: Starter $19, Scale $199, Business $999.
result.api_notes: REST API v2 with full OpenAPI schema (YAML/JSON). Covers Actors, versions, builds, runs, tasks, webhooks, schedules, Store, logs, users, usage, datasets, key-value stores, request queues. Official Node.js and Python clients. Rate limit 250k req/min global, 60 req/s per resource.

evidence.quote: Add the token to your request's Authorization header as Bearer <token>.
You can create an API token on the Integrations page in the Apify Console.
The API is organized around RESTful HTTP endpoints.
You can download the complete OpenAPI schema of Apify API in the YAML or JSON formats.
The Apify MCP server is an open-source project.
On first connection, your browser opens so you can sign in to Apify and approve access.
